statements.statement: The service billed is CPT 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and R42
The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
Continuous ambulatory cardiac monitoring is required to detect intermittent cardiac abnormalities that would otherwise be missed on intermittent office visits
